reasoning_traces.think:
The SAM operates as a layered probabilistic inference engine where each source contributes a reliability-weighted signal to downstream intelligence. The core duality lies between static source metadata (e.g., license status, update frequency) and dynamic performance indicators (accuracy, freshness). Failure modes emerge from data poisoning (unregistered sources), degradation (stale fetches), and systemic collapse (retired sources). The mesh enforces a feedback loop via settlement outcomes that recalibrate source scores, creating a self-correcting system. Each source's tier assignment acts as a conditional probability gate, filtering information flow according to its trustworthiness. The health status serves as a real-time observability layer, enabling GSE to dynamically adjust reasoning paths while GSI maintains calibrated uncertainty estimates across all tiers.
